newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to offer 15 mln pounds in 13-week t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to offer 15 mln pounds in 13-week t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 15 million pounds ($32.77 million) in 13-week treasury bills with a November 27 issue date, the bank said on Wednesday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, will be accepted from November 25 until 9.00 a.m. (0700 GMT) on November 27.
Competitive bids will be accepted either in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher to that set by the central bank for the specific issue. Other bids will be rejected.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the mean price of all competitive bids submitted and accepted by the Central Bank. ($1=0.457 pounds)
